sourcing.description: Scrape all sources, enrich, tailor, draft, and feed into review queue

followups.description: Check sent leads for replies and re-queue stale ones for follow-up

catalog_refresh.description: Sync the shared job catalog (companies/jobs) from Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby, and close out jobs no longer listed on the company's own board. This is what /api/jobs/matched and the anonymous /api/anon/resume feed actually match users against -- without this running, both are permanently empty regardless of how good a user's resume is.
